name: Rocknot's Ale

narrative.offerRewardText: What's this?  Ah!  It smells like Dark Iron Ale!  Drink has blurred my sight, but I can tell that you, sir, are a real friend!
narrative.requestItemsText: Oh, ale! I would kill for some Dark Iron ale!! Quick, I'm getting sober! I know this because sobriety blurs my vision... and it's making you look like the friend I slew last week!
